result.response:
The behavioral regression introduced in the refactor was in [`statusByCode`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-1678452192/acap-bench-3729211934/api/errors.go#L18-L25) within [api/errors.go](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-1678452192/acap-bench-3729211934/api/errors.go):

* [`CodeConflict`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-1678452192/acap-bench-3729211934/api/errors.go#L11) was mapped to `http.StatusBadRequest` (400) instead of `http.StatusConflict` (409), causing conflict responses (e.g. creating duplicate SKUs in [`createItem`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-1678452192/acap-bench-3729211934/api/handlers.go#L53-L65)) to return HTTP 400 instead of HTTP 409.

### Fix
Updated [`statusByCode`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-1678452192/acap-bench-3729211934/api/errors.go#L18-L25) in [api/errors.go](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-1678452192/acap-bench-3729211934/api/errors.go):
```go
var statusByCode = map[Code]int{
	CodeNotFound:   http.StatusNotFound,
	CodeBadQuery:   http.StatusBadRequest,
	CodeBadRequest: http.StatusBadRequest,
	CodeConflict:   http.StatusConflict,
	CodeQuota:      http.StatusTooManyRequests,
	CodeInternal:   http.StatusInternalServerError,
}
```

The refactor structure (`statusByCode` and [`respondError`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-1678452192/acap-bench-3729211934/api/handlers.go#L30-L34)) has been preserved, no tests were modified, and all test suites pass.
